title: Rate Manual: Computing the Converted Quarterly Installment on Term Life Insurance
content:
**Term Life Insurance rate manual — the converted quarterly installment.** When Ashgrove converts a policy to quarterly direct billing because its monthly bank-draft privilege ended at the returned-draft limit, the converted quarterly installment is set from the premium components as they stand on record, every rider still attached on record being charged.

## Definitions

- **Ages and years.** The insured's issue age is the whole years from the insured's date of birth to the issue date on record; the insured's anniversary age is the whole years from the insured's date of birth to the most recent policy anniversary on or before today; the policy years completed are the whole years from the issue date to today.
- **Band measurement face.** It is chosen by the owner's Ashgrove permanent coverage on the same insured: when an in-force Ashgrove whole life policy and an in-force Ashgrove universal life policy are both on record for the insured, it is the face amount on record plus both permanent face amounts; when exactly one of the two is in force for the insured, it is the face amount on record plus that one permanent face amount; otherwise it is the face amount on record alone.

## Components

1. **Band factor:** 1.00.
2. **Face premium:** the face amount on record divided by 1,000, times the rate per 1,000 on record, times the band factor, rounded to the cent.
3. **Fee before sharing,** set by the face amount on record: the product's annual policy fee less 10.00 below 250000; the product's annual policy fee less 20.00 at 1000000 or more; the product's annual policy fee from 250000 up to 1000000.
4. **Long-standing fee concession:** 10.00 once the policy has completed 20 policy years, 5.00 once it has completed 10 policy years, nothing before that.
5. **Policy fee share:** the whole fee.
6. **Policy fee:** the fee before sharing less the long-standing fee concession, never below nothing, times the policy fee share, rounded to the cent.
7. **Accidental death rider rate:** 1.08 per 1,000 when the insured's anniversary age is from 60 through 69 (60 or more and below 70); 0.84 per 1,000 when it is below 45; the product's accidental death rider rate per 1,000 at any other age.
8. **Accidental death charge:** the accidental death rider amount on record divided by 1,000, times the accidental death rider rate, rounded to the cent.
9. **Children's term unit rate:** 5.00 when 11 or more units are on record; 5.50 when 5 through 10 units are on record; the product's children's term rate per unit below 5 units.
10. **Children's term charge:** the units on record times the children's term unit rate.
11. **Waiver rate:** 0.11. **Waiver charge base:** the face premium alone.
12. **Waiver charge:** when the waiver of premium rider is attached on record, the waiver rate times the waiver charge base, rounded to the cent; when it is not attached there is no waiver charge.
13. **Annual premium:** the face premium plus the policy fee, the accidental death charge, the children's term charge and the waiver charge.
14. **Converted quarterly installment:** the annual premium times the product's quarterly factor, rounded to the cent.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

Ashgrove Level Term 20; face on record 300000; rate per 1,000 on record 1.20; 9 policy years completed; anniversary age 47; accidental death rider 100000; 6 children's units; waiver rider attached; no permanent coverage on the insured.

| Component | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Face premium | 300 times 1.20 times 1.00 | 360.00 |
| Policy fee | fee before sharing 70.00, less no concession, times the whole fee | 70.00 |
| Accidental death charge | 100 times 0.96 | 96.00 |
| Children's term charge | 6 times 5.50 | 33.00 |
| Waiver charge | 0.11 times 360.00 | 39.60 |
| Annual premium | total of the above | 598.60 |
| Converted quarterly installment | 598.60 times 0.265, rounded | 158.63 |

Hypothetical concession boundary: a policy with exactly 10 completed policy years takes 5.00; with 9, nothing. Hypothetical floor: a fee before sharing of 50.00 less a concession of 10.00 gives 40.00; the fee never goes below nothing.
